supported_guidance: Maintain adequate daily hydration with plain water while avoiding sugar-sweetened beverages.
Continue taking prescribed Metformin as directed; do not alter dosages without medical instruction.
Ensure adequate rest and pace physical activities while experiencing tiredness.
Keep a log of daily fluid intake, urination frequency, and any home blood glucose readings to share with your provider.
Seek immediate medical care if you experience warning signs such as severe lightheadedness, confusion, persistent vomiting, deep rapid breathing, or severe abdominal pain.
